leaveCaseHint: A manager must verify the event, relationship and eligible dates. Allowances are calculated automatically. Do not duplicate an event. Maternity periods include rest days and use full calendar days (midnight, exclusive end). Partner prenatal and childbirth leave share 7 days; verify the eligible dates for each request. The maternity daily wage is calculated from the agreed and average wages. The paid percentage is calculated from seniority. For parental leave, reuse the same reference for that child. The period must end by the third birthday. Service under six months requires employer–employee agreement. No daily wage is required.
leaveRequestHint: Managers verify medical documentation for hospitalization and pregnancy bed rest. Sick leave (including hospitalization and pregnancy bed rest) is paid at half wage for up to 30 days per year combined and is unpaid beyond that. Menstrual leave is 1 day per month at half wage; the first 3 days each year do not count toward sick leave, and from the 4th day they count toward those 30 days. For parental leave, select the allowance granted by a manager and use whole calendar days (midnight, exclusive end).

overtimeExtensionPeriods.hint: Add only after approval by the union (or labor-management meeting if there is no union). Each period covers 3 consecutive months with up to 54 overtime hours a month and 138 hours in total; other months are limited to 46 hours. Employers with 30 or more employees must file with the local authority.

overtimeOnShift: On a rest day, public holiday or regular leave day, the whole shift counts as overtime. Enter the hours actually worked.
overtimeOnWorkday: Overtime must directly precede the shift start or follow the shift end, and the day's total including regular hours cannot exceed 12 hours. Monthly overtime cannot exceed 46 hours; within periods approved by the union or labor-management meeting, it cannot exceed 54 hours a month or 138 hours per 3 months.
parentalChildHint: Reuse the existing record for the same child. A manager must verify evidence and assign a stable reference. Register twins separately; do not enter full national ID numbers. Assign existing parental leave allowances to a verified child.
parentalReturnHint: Another manager must approve the return. Leave remains active until approval. Approval preserves leave already taken and the original record. Leave ends at the start of the return date.
